why: The verdict 'Mostly true' contradicts the story's own finding. The text says the core claim (stubble is not the principal cause) is 'not yet proven', and that the order does not put vehicles at the centre or name them the main cause, so both halves of the claim as stated are unsupported. The 'finding' line also says burning counts in Punjab, Haryana and Uttar Pradesh 'fell sharply', but the story's own figures show Uttar Pradesh NCR rising (72, 108, 192). The Hindi standfirst has a grammar error ('दिल्ली के धुंध' should be 'दिल्ली की धुंध'), and the Hindi headline drops 'pollution' ('पराली दिल्ली की मुख्य वजह नहीं' reads as 'stubble is not Delhi's main reason').
